title: RDT-1B: a Diffusion Foundation Model for Bimanual Manipulation

live_model.evidence: "we utilize GPT-4-Turbo (Achiam et al., 2023) to rewrite human-annotated instructions to increase text diversity"; "utilize GPT-4-Turbo to generate 100 expanded instructions and one simplified instruction for each task."

claim.metric: none (paraphrase/augmentation utility for training data, not a scored LLM capability)

data.source: RDT-1B robot manipulation dataset (paper's own release)

notes: GPT-4-Turbo is used purely to paraphrase/expand instruction text for the robot-manipulation training corpus; no capability metric is attributed to it.
